trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer for dashboard connection contention
trello.desc: Dashboard is slow for accounts with lots of projects. Profiling shows 80% of time is waiting on database due to connection contention, not query cost. Raj to take a proper look at connection pooling instead of migrating databases. Set up a load test that mirrors the dashboard's query pattern and benchmark PgBouncer in transaction mode against current setup. Bring numbers to next sync. Decision confirmed: staying on Postgres, no MongoDB migration or evaluation task will be created.

trello.name: Fix typo in onboarding email subject line
trello.desc: Marketing spotted typo 'recieve' in onboarding email subject line. Tom to fix it and get it re-approved. Five-minute job. Push the fix through the email template repo today.

trello.name: Update roadmap doc for dark mode placement
trello.desc: Roadmap doc still shows dark mode under 'Q3 committed' which is now incorrect. Dark mode is not being built this cycle; it comes for free with the September design-system upgrade which ships with theming built in, tokens, dark palette. Tom to update the roadmap: move dark mode under the September design-system upgrade line so sales stops promising it as standalone. Decision: no dark mode build this cycle, no theme system or asset variant work for dark mode now.
